title: Three O'Clock Lullaby
idea: A man who cannot sleep goes downstairs and is rocked to sleep by his own blinking machines, while the neighbour at the window keeps watch over them both.
rule: Moonlight and lantern light always come from screen-left, the machines' green-and-blue blink always comes from screen-right, and Seth only ever moves or leans toward the right.

motifs.clock tick: Seth's head ticking side to side like the pendulum of the tall clock on the landing; fast and wide awake at the start, a slow drowsy nod at the end of the bridge
motifs.celesta twinkles: the rows of small green and blue rack lights, always screen-right, brighter each time: a glow under the stairs, a stripe through the door, the full rack, a field of stars round him, lights he conducts
motifs.muted trumpet: the moonlit four-pane window at screen-left: empty at first, then Wilson's hat peeking above the sill, then Wilson in full with his lantern, then Wilson's final portrait
motifs.electric hum / fans breathing: Seth's hair and quilt lifting and falling in the fans' warm breeze, as if the room breathes
motifs.hummed Oohs and choir: a close-up hum with soft rounded lips into the lens (Seth in the intro); the closing choir belongs to Wilson's still face at the window
motifs.chorus 'Hum me a lullaby': the rack-low setup: close, low three-quarter from the rack's side, Seth's face lit green from screen-right, singing into the lens; each return is drowsier and nearer the rack

bible.style: A 1930s rubber-hose cartoon drawn in warm sepia ink with halftone shading, bold clean brown outlines and deep umber shadows, where the only colour accents are small glowing green and blue lights.
bible.light: Pale cool moonlight always enters from screen-left, the racks' soft green and blue glow always comes from screen-right, and Wilson's lantern adds a small warm amber glow on the screen-left side; everything else falls into deep night shadow.

locations.stairs: A dark wooden staircase at night: a bare top landing of floorboards with a tall grandfather clock against its left wall (plain round face, two black hands, a brass pendulum behind a glass door), a long rectangle of moonlight across the landing, and the stairs with a turned wooden banister dropping away to the right into darkness, where a faint green glow rises from below.
locations.hallway: A narrow dark hallway with bare floorboards and plain plaster walls: at its left end a tall four-pane wooden window with a big round moon resting on the sill and a moonlit yard with a low hedge beyond the glass, and at its right end a small wooden closet door standing a hand's width open, with a vertical stripe of green light falling through the gap onto the floor.
locations.closet: A small dark closet with bare floorboards: three chest-high black server racks with flat tops stand side by side along the right wall, their fronts covered in rows of tiny glowing green and blue dots and round fan grilles, and an open doorway in the left wall shows a slice of moonlit hallway.

landing-high.camera: High angle from above the top landing looking down: the grandfather clock at screen-left, the moonlight rectangle on the landing in the middle, and the full staircase dropping away to screen-right toward the green glow.

stairs-mid.camera: Eye level, three-quarter from the right side of the staircase halfway down, looking across the steps with the banister behind, the green glow rising from below at screen-right and moonlight spilling down from the landing at screen-left.

hallway-long.camera: Eye level, three-quarter view along the length of the hallway: the window and the moon at screen-left, the open closet door with its green stripe at screen-right.

window-front.camera: Eye level from inside the hallway, facing the window nearly straight on from slightly to its right, so the window fills the frame left of centre, the moon sits at the left of the sill and the moonlit yard shows through the four panes.

closet-wide.camera: Eye level from the back of the closet looking along the aisle: the open moonlit doorway at screen-left, the racks receding along the right two-thirds of the frame.

closet-high.camera: Steep high angle from the ceiling corner above the doorway, looking down at the floorboards, with the racks' glowing fronts and flat tops running along screen-right and the doorway's moonlight spilling in from screen-left.

rack-low.camera: Low three-quarter from beside the nearest rack at rack-top height, looking up and to the left: the rack's glowing front edge runs down the right edge of the frame, and the moonlit doorway is small and far back at screen-left.

props.quilt: A faded patchwork quilt of square patches in cream, tan and dusty blue, alternating plain squares with small-check squares, with a scalloped cream border and a few loose threads at one corner.
props.lantern: An old tin oil lantern with a domed vented lid, a wire carrying bail on top, a clear glass chimney around a small amber flame, and a round dented tin base.
props.chair: A small plain wooden kitchen chair with four turned legs, a flat square seat, and a back of three vertical spindles under a curved top rail.

shots.lyric: (clock ticking, celesta alone)
shots.still: Wide, full figure: Seth stands small on the landing just right of the clock, wide-eyed and upright in grey wool socks, the quilt wrapped round his shoulders like a cape and held closed at his chest with one hand. His head tilts to one side like a pendulum at the end of its swing. Moonlight from screen-left falls on his front; a faint green tint touches his screen-right side.
shots.action: His head ticks left, then right, in exact time with the swinging pendulum, eyes wide awake; on the last tick his head stops tilted toward the green glow at screen-right.
shots.role: sets up clock tick

shots.lyric: (celesta)
shots.still: Medium, cropped at the waist, Seth right of centre beside the newel post at the top of the stairs, his body turned three-quarter toward screen-right and leaning slightly right: both hands clutch the quilt's cream, tan and dusty-blue patchwork closed under his chin, eyebrows half-raised, eyes looking down and to screen-right toward the stairwell. Soft green light from below-right glows on the screen-right side of his face and on the quilt; pale moonlight from screen-left rims his long wavy hair.
shots.action: The green light on his face blinks softly twice like a twinkle; his eyebrows lift and he leans toward it; he takes one long tiptoe step down to the right.
shots.role: sets up celesta twinkles

shots.lyric: Ooh... ooh...
shots.still: Close, head and shoulders, his face turned straight to the camera: the quilt's patchwork edge is gathered at his chin, his lips are softly rounded in a hum under the handlebar moustache, and his eyelids are half-lowered. Green light glows on the screen-right side of his face; moonlight touches the screen-left side.
shots.action: Hums with rounded lips, chest rising and falling slowly; on the second hum he looks straight into the lens and his head sways once toward screen-right.
shots.role: sets up hummed Oohs

shots.lyric: It's three o'clock, the house is still,
shots.still: Wide, full figure, small, halfway down the staircase at screen-right: Seth is mid-tiptoe with one knee lifted high rubber-hose style, his back to the camera and his head turned to look back up over his shoulder. The quilt trails behind him over the steps. Moonlight from screen-left on his back, green glow on his front from below.
shots.action: He tiptoes down two steps on the beat with high springy knees, bobbing; on 'still' he looks back up over his shoulder into the lens and freezes mid-step.
shots.role: repeats clock tick (the tiptoe keeps the tick)

shots.lyric: The moon is parked on the windowsill,
shots.still: Medium, waist up, at screen-left beside the window: Seth's body is turned toward screen-right and his face turned back left toward the moon, one finger raised to his lips in a shush, the quilt on his shoulders. Pale moonlight from screen-left lights his face and chest.
shots.action: He presses a finger to his lips toward the moon in a conspiratorial shush; then he turns to the right, looks into the lens and gives a small sly smile.
shots.role: sets up muted trumpet (the window, empty)

shots.lyric: I tiptoe down in my stocking feet
shots.still: Wide, full figure in the middle of the hallway, mid-sneak toward screen-right: Seth is stretched tall and thin in cartoon squash-and-stretch on the toes of his grey wool socks, one long leg reaching forward, the quilt dragging along the floorboards behind him. Moonlight on his back from screen-left, green on his front from screen-right.
shots.action: Long rubber-hose tiptoe strides toward screen-right, his whole body stretching up on each step and squashing down on the beat; on 'feet' he glances down at the lens.
shots.role: escalates clock tick (the walk becomes a dance)

shots.lyric: To the little closet where the servers sleep.
shots.still: Medium, waist up, at screen-right at the closet door: Seth peeks round its edge with one hand on the door, the green stripe of light from the gap falling across one eye and his moustache. The quilt is on his shoulders; moonlight is on his back from screen-left.
shots.action: He eases the door wider with one hand and the green stripe widens across his face; on 'sleep' he turns his lit eye into the lens and lays his cheek on his folded hands like a pillow.
shots.role: escalates celesta twinkles (a stripe of light)

shots.lyric: A hundred lights in a row of green,
shots.still: Wide, full figure, small in the doorway at screen-left: Seth stands with his arms half-raised in wonder and his mouth open, the quilt on his shoulders, his whole front lit green from the racks at screen-right and moonlight rimming his back.
shots.action: His arms open wide in wonder as the rows of lights blink in a ripple; he takes one step in toward screen-right and rises onto his toes.
shots.role: escalates celesta twinkles (the full rack revealed)

shots.lyric: The softest sound that I've ever seen,
shots.still: Close, head and shoulders, three-quarter toward screen-right: Seth's face is lit green from screen-right with tiny points of green light reflected in both eyes, one hand cupped behind his ear toward the racks, the quilt's edge at his shoulders.
shots.action: He listens with the cupped hand at his ear, then slides the cupped hand round in front of his eye like a little telescope; on 'seen' he looks into the lens through it and holds the open vowel.
shots.role: repeats celesta twinkles (lights in his eyes)

shots.lyric: They blink at me like the stars came in
shots.still: Wide, full figure seen from above in the middle of the floor: Seth's face is tipped up toward the camera, eyes wide, arms slightly out, the quilt fanned round him on the floor in a full circle. Tiny green and blue specks of light from screen-right freckle him and the quilt like stars.
shots.action: He gazes straight up into the lens and blinks slowly, in time with the lights around him; he turns once on the spot toward screen-right and the quilt fans out.
shots.role: escalates celesta twinkles (the lights become the stars)

shots.lyric: To keep me company again.
shots.still: Medium, waist up, left of centre, his body facing the racks at screen-right: Seth raises one hand in a small shy wave, his face turned back over his shoulder toward the camera with a bashful grin, the quilt on his shoulders. Green light on his front, moonlight on his back from screen-left.
shots.action: He waves shyly at the racks with a little wiggle of the fingers, then looks back over his shoulder into the lens with a bashful grin on 'again'.
shots.role: sets up the machines as company

shots.lyric: Hum me a lullaby, little machine,
shots.still: Close, head and shoulders, seen from below: Seth looks down into the camera, awake and tender, his face brightly lit green from screen-right, one hand resting flat on the rack's front at the right edge of the frame like on a piano lid, the quilt at his shoulders.
shots.action: He sings straight into the lens; his head sways gently side to side on the beat; on 'machine' his fingers tap the rack front once like a key.
shots.role: sets up chorus framing

shots.lyric: Blink me to sleep in your blue and your green,
shots.still: Medium, waist up, in profile facing the racks at screen-right: Seth holds one index finger raised like a conductor's baton toward the rows of lights, chin lifted, the quilt hanging from his shoulders. Green light falls on his face and finger from screen-right.
shots.action: His finger beats time in small arcs and the rows of lights blink on each stroke; on 'green' he turns his face into the lens and holds the baton up.
shots.role: escalates celesta twinkles (he plays the lights like an instrument)

shots.lyric: Nobody's paging and nothing is down,
shots.still: Wide, full figure in the middle of the aisle: Seth is mid-waltz-turn with his arms out, the quilt flaring round him like a skirt, one stocking foot lifted, his face relaxed. Green from screen-right, moonlight from screen-left.
shots.action: He does one lazy waltz turn toward screen-right with the quilt swirling out, bobbing on the beat, and ends facing the lens with his arms open and easy.
shots.role: repeats electric hum (the quilt moves with the room)

shots.lyric: Just you and me in the quietest town.
shots.still: Medium, framing the lower panes and the sill: only the top of Wilson's bucket hat and his two white oval eyes in the shadow under its brim peek up above the outside of the sill, just right of the moon; the rest of him is hidden below. Moonlight from screen-left catches the hat brim.
shots.action: The white oval eyes blink once, slowly; then the bucket hat sinks down below the sill and out of sight.
shots.role: escalates muted trumpet (the window is not empty)

shots.lyric: Hum me a lullaby, sing me a byte,
shots.still: Close, nearer than the first chorus: Seth's face fills most of the frame, his cheek almost touching the rack front at the right edge, eyelids heavy, rows of tiny green and blue dots reflected in his eyes, the quilt pulled up to his chin. Strong green light from screen-right.
shots.action: He sings into the lens with drowsy half-closed eyes; his head drifts slowly down toward the rack on the beat; on 'byte' he gives a slow sleepy smile.
shots.role: escalates chorus framing (closer, drowsier)

shots.lyric: Everything's running, and running all right.
shots.still: Medium, waist up, right of centre near the racks, three-quarter toward the camera: Seth gives a sleepy thumbs-up toward screen-right, his eyes heavy, the quilt slipping off one shoulder. Green from screen-right, moonlight on his back from screen-left.
shots.action: He holds the thumbs-up toward the racks; on 'all right' his mouth stretches into an enormous rubber-hose yawn that squashes his whole face, then he blinks into the lens.
shots.role: sets up sleep taking hold

shots.lyric: The fans go round like a gentle sea,
shots.still: Wide, full figure in the middle of the aisle, in profile facing screen-right: Seth's eyes are closed and his body leans toward the racks, the quilt billowing out behind him and his long wavy hair lifting in a warm breeze from screen-right.
shots.action: His whole body rocks slowly left and right like a boat on a swell, the quilt rising and falling with each sway, always leaning back toward the racks.
shots.role: escalates electric hum (the room breathes him)

shots.lyric: The disks are whispering back to me,
shots.still: Close, his head in profile facing screen-right: Seth's ear and cheek are pressed flat against the front of the nearest rack at the right edge of the frame, eyes closed, a contented smile under his handlebar moustache, green dots glowing beside his face, the quilt's edge at his shoulder.
shots.action: He listens with his ear to the rack and his smile widens; on 'me' his eyes open and slide to the lens without lifting his head.
shots.role: repeats electric hum

shots.lyric: I pull a chair and I rest my head
shots.still: Medium, from the knees up, three-quarter toward the camera, Seth left of centre: Seth faces the camera and steps backward toward the racks at screen-right, pulling the small wooden chair after him by its curved top rail with both hands, knees bent rubber-hose style, his mouth open mid-word and his whole face in view. The patchwork quilt hangs from his shoulders. Green light from the racks on his screen-right side; pale moonlight from screen-left on his face and chest.
shots.action: He drags the chair to the rack with a springy rubber-hose tug on the beat, then drops onto it with a soft bounce and looks into the lens.
shots.role: sets up the bed he makes of the rack

shots.lyric: On the warmest rack that was ever made.
shots.still: Close, head and shoulders, Seth at screen-right: Seth stands bent forward against the nearest black server rack, his head lying sideways on his folded arms on the rack's flat black metal top, one arm hugging the rack's edge. Just below his arms, the rack's black metal front shows rows of tiny glowing green and blue dots. His eyelids are nearly shut and a soft smile sits under his handlebar moustache; the patchwork quilt is draped round his shoulders. Green light from the rack on his cheek from screen-right; pale moonlight from screen-left on his hair.
shots.action: He nuzzles his cheek into his arms on the rack and hugs it closer; on 'made' he sings the held note softly into the lens and his eyes close.
shots.role: escalates chorus framing (his head reaches the rack)

shots.lyric: Go on up to bed now, son,
shots.still: Wide, the whole window in frame: Wilson stands outside in the moonlit yard just beyond the glass, his bucket hat and white oval eyes in the upper panes beside the moon and his picket slats filling the lower panes, the window's wooden bars crossing in front of his body. He holds the lantern up outside the glass in his screen-left white glove, its small amber flame glowing warm on his screen-left slats, and his free white glove points gently upward. Pale moonlight from screen-left on his slats and hat brim; the hallway floorboards in front of the window lie bare and dark.
shots.action: He lifts the lantern a little higher and tilts his bucket hat in a slow, kind nod on 'son'; his free white glove points gently upward, toward the stairs.
shots.role: escalates muted trumpet (Wilson in full)

shots.lyric: it'll keep till the morning sun.
shots.still: Close, the window glass filling the frame: Wilson is outside behind the glass, his bucket-hat brim and white oval eyes filling one pane, the pane's wooden bars framing his face, his eyes softened into gentle crescents. One white-gloved fingertip presses against the outside of the glass. The lantern hangs from his other glove outside the window at the screen-left edge, a small warm amber flame reflected in the glass. Pale moonlight from screen-left on his hat brim.
shots.action: His white eyes soften into gentle crescents; he taps the glass once, very softly, with his fingertip; then he looks straight into the lens.
shots.role: escalates muted trumpet

shots.lyric: (strings swell, celesta)
shots.still: Medium, seen from above: Seth sits on the small wooden chair pulled close against the racks at screen-right, slumped forward, his head resting on his own folded arms on the flat black top of the nearest rack, his long wavy hair spilling over his sleeves. His face is half-turned up toward the doorway at screen-left, eyes sleepy and heavy-lidded. The patchwork quilt slides off his shoulders down the chair back. Green light on his arms and cheek from screen-right; a pale rectangle of moonlight across his back from screen-left.
shots.action: He lifts his head halfway and glances sleepily toward the doorway at screen-left; his head nods slowly once, twice, like a slowing pendulum, and settles back onto the rack to the right.
shots.role: escalates clock tick (the pendulum runs down)

shots.lyric: Oh, but who would watch them through the night,
shots.still: Close, low view from beside the rack, Seth's face in the centre of the frame: his head lies sideways on the flat black metal top of the nearest server rack, face turned toward the camera, eyes almost closed, a faint smile under his handlebar moustache. The rack's black metal front, with rows of tiny glowing green and blue dots, runs down the right edge of the frame just under his cheek. The patchwork quilt is bunched round his shoulders and under his chin. Strong green light on his cheek and moustache from screen-right; faint moonlight from screen-left on his hair.
shots.action: Without lifting his head he sings one last time into the lens through barely open eyes; on 'night' he holds the open vowel and his eyes drift shut.
shots.role: escalates chorus framing (pays it off)

shots.lyric: Who would tuck in every little light?
shots.still: Wide, full figure: Seth sits half asleep on the chair right of centre, drawing the quilt off his shoulders and over the top of the nearest rack at screen-right, green and blue dots glowing softly through its patches. Moonlight from the doorway at screen-left on his back.
shots.action: He smooths the quilt over the rack like tucking in a child, then lays his cheek down on it and is still.
shots.role: escalates the quilt (prop pays off)

shots.lyric: (choir hum to silence)
shots.still: Close, straight on, a quiet still portrait through the window: Wilson stands outside behind the glass, his bucket-hat brim and two calm white oval eyes in its shadow filling the centre panes, the window's wooden bars crossing in front of his slats and the moon glowing just above his hat. The lantern hangs lowered in his white glove outside the glass at the screen-left edge, a small warm amber flame. A faint green reflection sits in the glass at screen-right; pale moonlight from screen-left on his hat brim.
shots.action: He holds still and keeps watch, eyes steady on the lens; one slow blink, then he does not move.
shots.role: pays off muted trumpet (the answer to 'who would watch'), still portrait
